scenario: 面试官只说“设计 YouTube”，没有限定要不要做搜索、评论、推荐或频道管理。
q: 这道题该把系统边界圈定在哪两个核心功能？
options: 只做广告投放和创作者结算
只做离线推荐模型训练
上传视频 + 观看（流式播放）视频
完整社区功能：搜索、评论、推荐、频道管理
options_en: Only build ad serving and creator payouts.
Only build offline recommendation model training.
Video upload plus watching (streaming) video.
The full social product: search, comments, recommendations, channels.
why: 范围定在上传和观看两条主路径，能把大 blob 处理和流式播放这两个真正难的问题讲透；社区类功能留在范围外。
why_en: Scoping YouTube to upload and watching keeps the interview focused on large-blob handling and streaming instead of social features.
q_en: What two core features should define the YouTube design scope?
scenario_en: The interviewer only says design YouTube and has not scoped search, comments, recommendations, or channel management.
optionExplanations: 这把 YouTube 做成广告平台，偏离了上传和观看这两条要考的主路径。
这假设范围是离线推荐训练管线，不是这道题要设计的产品主路径。
上传和流式观看是这题真正要打磨的两条主路径，能把大文件处理和播放讲透。
把评论、搜索、频道管理全部收进范围会让这场面试摊得太开，讲不透任何一层。
optionExplanations_en: This scopes the system as an ads platform, missing the upload/watch paths the interview actually tests.
This treats the problem as an offline ML training pipeline, not the product surface being designed.
Upload plus streaming watch are the two paths worth going deep on here, covering large-blob handling and playback.
Pulling in search, comments, and channels spreads the interview too thin to go deep on anything.

scenario: 面试官已经把范围收窄到视频分享本身，还没提搜索、评论这些附加功能。
q: YouTube 题的核心功能需求有哪些？（多选）
options: 用户可以上传视频
用户可以观看/流式播放视频
用户可以搜索视频
用户可以评论视频
options_en: Users can upload videos.
Users can watch (stream) videos.
Users can search for videos.
Users can comment on videos.
why: 核心功能只有上传和观看；搜索、评论、推荐、频道管理都被推到范围外，好把非功能需求讲透。
why_en: The two core functions are uploading and watching videos; search and comments are explicitly out of scope.
q_en: Which features are core requirements for the YouTube design? (Select all that apply.)
scenario_en: The scope has been narrowed to video sharing itself, before optional features like search and comments are added.
optionExplanations: 上传是创作者往系统写入内容的核心路径，必须在核心范围内。
观看/流式播放是这道题真正要设计的读路径，同样在核心范围内。
搜索会把范围拉向索引和排序系统，这道题已经把它推到范围外。
评论是社区功能，这里没有被选进核心范围，留给后续深挖。
optionExplanations_en: Upload is the core write path creators need, so it belongs in scope.
Watch/streaming is the read path this interview is actually about, so it stays in scope.
Search pulls in indexing and ranking work that this problem explicitly pushes out of scope.
Comments are a social feature that was not selected as core scope here.

scenario: 功能需求只有上传和观看两条，非功能需求因此要承担更多设计压力。
q: YouTube 题的核心非功能需求包括哪些？（多选）
options: 高可用，优先可用性而非强一致
支持几十 GB 的大视频上传和播放
低带宽环境下仍能低延迟播放
支持断点续传
所有观看计数必须强一致实时更新
options_en: Highly available, favoring availability over strong consistency.
Supports uploading and streaming very large videos (tens of GB).
Stays low-latency even on low-bandwidth connections.
Supports resumable uploads.
All view counts update with strong real-time consistency.
why: 非功能主线是高可用、大文件、弱网低延迟播放和断点续传；观看计数属于附加深挖，不是核心非功能需求。
why_en: The core nonfunctional needs are availability, large-video support, low-latency streaming, and resumable upload; view counts are a separate deep dive.
q_en: Which nonfunctional requirements are core to the YouTube design? (Select all that apply.)
scenario_en: The product scope is only upload and watch, so the nonfunctional requirements drive most of the design.
optionExplanations: 高可用换来的是允许暂时看到旧数据，但上传和观看服务不能整体下线。
几十 GB 视频这个体积决定了必须走对象存储直传和分块上传，而不是单次内存缓冲。
弱网低延迟要求逼着系统做分段流式播放而不是等整文件下载完。
断点续传要求每个 chunk 单独记录状态，断线后才能跳过已完成部分。
观看计数就算要精确到实时强一致，也该单独拎出来当附加题讨论，不算这里要扛的非功能主线。
optionExplanations_en: Favoring availability means metadata can be briefly stale, but upload and watch must stay up.
Tens-of-GB file sizes are why the design needs direct-to-object upload and chunked parts instead of buffering in memory.
Low-latency-on-weak-networks pushes the design toward segment streaming instead of waiting for a full download.
Resumable upload means each chunk needs its own tracked status so a reconnect can skip finished parts.
Even if view counts needed exact real-time consistency, that belongs in a separate deep dive, not the nonfunctional thread carried here.

scenario: 面试量级假设：约 100 万视频上传/天，1 亿视频观看/天。
q: 这个读写比量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 读远大于写，元数据和播放路径要靠缓存、CDN 扛热点读
写入量更大，元数据和上传路径要靠分布式事务与队列扛写热点
读写比接近 1:1，不需要额外缓存层
这个量级下应放弃分区，直接用单机数据库
options_en: Reads dominate writes; metadata and playback need caching and a CDN for hot reads.
Writes are the larger load, so metadata and the upload path need distributed transactions and a queue for write hot spots.
Reads and writes are roughly balanced, so no extra caching layer is needed.
At this scale, drop partitioning and use a single-node database.
why: 读写比约 100:1，说明读扩展才是重点：元数据缓存、CDN、读副本都要为高读比服务。
why_en: With roughly a hundred times more views than uploads, the system must scale reads through caching and a CDN rather than the write path.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers close to users and serves it from nearby.

q_en: What design judgment does this read/write ratio support?
scenario_en: Use the interview scale assumption: about 1 million video uploads per day and 100 million video views per day.
optionExplanations: 上传和观看差了约百倍，这个比例说明真正要扛的是读，缓存和 CDN 得为读路径撑腰。
这题的负载明显是读多写少，把资源砸在上传事务上找错了瓶颈。
这只有在读写量级真的接近 1:1 时才成立，而这里差了两个数量级。
量级越大越需要水平扩展，直接退回单机数据库正好搞反了方向。
optionExplanations_en: Views outnumber uploads by roughly a hundred to one, so the bottleneck to scale is reads, not writes.
This chases the write path when the load here is clearly read-heavy by a wide margin.
This only holds if reads and writes were roughly equal, but the ratio here is nowhere close.
Scale this large calls for horizontal partitioning, not a retreat to a single-node database.

scenario: 定义完功能和非功能需求后，还没进入 API 设计，需要先列出核心实体。
q: YouTube 题的核心实体有哪些？（多选）
options: User
Video
VideoMetadata
Business
options_en: User
Video
VideoMetadata
Business
why: User 是上传者或观看者，Video 是媒体本体，VideoMetadata 存标题、状态、对象存储引用等。Business 是 Yelp 题的实体，不属于这里。
why_en: The core entities are User, Video, and VideoMetadata; Business belongs to a different interview problem (Yelp), not YouTube.
q_en: Which core entities belong in the YouTube design? (Select all that apply.)
scenario_en: After requirements are set, list the core entities before designing APIs.
optionExplanations: User 既是上传者又是观看者，两个角色都要挂在这一个实体上。
Video 是被上传和观看的媒体本体，是整个系统绕着转的对象。
标题、状态和对象存储 URL 这些字段都挂在这张表上，是元数据服务真正落地读写的地方。
Business 是本地商家实体，属于 Yelp 类题目，这里没有商家概念。
optionExplanations_en: User covers both the uploader and the viewer role on one entity.
Video is the media object being uploaded and watched, the thing the whole system revolves around.
VideoMetadata holds title, status, and storage pointers, the table the metadata service actually reads and writes.
Business is a local-business entity that belongs to a Yelp-style problem, not this one.

scenario: 在设计存储和转码之前，需要先对齐视频领域的几个基础词汇。
q: 视频 codec 的主要作用是什么？
options: 决定 API Gateway 的路由规则
保证数据库的 ACID 事务
把用户评论转成搜索索引
压缩和解压视频，在体积与质量间取舍
options_en: It decides API Gateway routing rules.
It guarantees the database's ACID transactions.
It turns user comments into a search index.
It compresses and decompresses video, trading off size against quality.
why: codec 是编解码方案，如 H.264、AV1；它影响文件大小、播放兼容性和转码成本，不是数据库或路由层的概念。
why_en: A codec such as H.264 or AV1 compresses and decompresses video, shaping file size, compatibility, and transcoding cost.

termDefinitions.meaning: 压缩和解压视频数据的编解码方案，如 H.264、AV1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A codec compresses and decompresses video data, such as H.264 or AV1.

q_en: What is the main role of a video codec?
scenario_en: Before designing storage and transcoding, align on basic video-domain vocabulary.
optionExplanations: 网关路由是请求转发层的事，跟视频怎么编码完全不搭边。
ACID 是数据库事务保证的概念，不是媒体格式在管的事。
评论转索引属于搜索/内容发现管线，不是编解码的职责。
codec（如 H.264、AV1）负责在文件体积和播放质量之间取舍，压缩和解压视频数据。
optionExplanations_en: Gateway routing forwards requests; it has nothing to do with how video is encoded.
ACID describes database transaction guarantees, not a media format concept.
Turning comments into a search index belongs to content discovery, not codec work.
A codec such as H.264 or AV1 compresses and decompresses the video data, trading file size against quality.

scenario: 面试官追问 codec 和 container 是不是同一回事。
q: codec 和 container 的区别是什么？
options: codec 只用于音频，container 只用于 DNS
codec 管压缩解压，container 管封装格式和元数据
二者没有区别，可以互换使用
codec 是数据库，container 是缓存
options_en: Codec is only for audio, and container is only for DNS.
The codec handles compression and decoding, while the container handles the file's packaging format and metadata.
They are identical and interchangeable.
Codec is a database, and container is a cache.
why: codec 解决视频如何编码，container 解决视频、音频和元数据如何打包成一个文件；不同设备对二者的组合支持不同。
why_en: The codec defines how video is compressed, while the container defines how video, audio, and metadata are packaged into a file.
tradeoff: codec：压缩/解码算法 vs container：文件封装格式

termDefinitions.meaning: 压缩和解压视频数据的编解码方案，如 H.264、AV1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A codec compresses and decompresses video data, such as H.264 or AV1.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频、音频和元数据打包在一起的文件封装格式，和 codec 是两回事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A container is the file format that packages video, audio, and metadata together, distinct from the codec.

q_en: What is the difference between a codec and a container?
scenario_en: The interviewer asks whether codec and container mean the same thing.
optionExplanations: codec 不是只管音频，container 也不是 DNS 的事，这个说法把两个概念都换错了对象。
codec 决定怎么压缩解压视频，container 决定怎么把视频、音频、元数据打包进一个文件，两者管的是不同层。
如果二者可以互换，就不会有播放器支持某个 codec 却打不开某个 container 的兼容性问题了。
把 codec 和 container 类比成数据库和缓存，混淆了媒体编码层和存储系统层。
optionExplanations_en: Codec is not audio-only, and container is not DNS; this swaps both concepts for the wrong things.
The codec decides how video is compressed and decoded, while the container decides how video, audio, and metadata get packaged into one file — two different layers.
If they were interchangeable, players would never hit compatibility issues supporting a codec but not its container.
Comparing codec and container to a database and a cache confuses the media-encoding layer with the storage-system layer.

scenario: 设计自适应码率播放前，需要先说清 bitrate 这个词具体指什么。
q: 视频 bitrate 表示什么？
options: Cassandra 的分区数量
单位时间传输比特数，受分辨率影响
CDN 边缘节点数量
每天上传的视频数量
options_en: Cassandra's partition count.
Bits transmitted per unit time, shaped by resolution.
The CDN's edge-node count.
The number of videos uploaded per day.
why: 高分辨率、高帧率通常带来更高 bitrate；自适应码率播放正是根据客户端带宽在不同 bitrate 的片段间切换。
why_en: Bitrate is bits transmitted per unit time, and adaptive streaming switches between segments at different bitrates based on bandwidth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间传输的比特数，分辨率、帧率和压缩效率都会影响它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bitrate is the number of bits transmitted per unit time, shaped by resolution, frame rate, and compression.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers close to users and serves it from nearby.

q_en: What does video bitrate mean?
scenario_en: Before adaptive bitrate playback, define what bitrate actually measures.
optionExplanations: 分区数量是数据库容量概念，跟视频每秒传多少比特毫无关系。
bitrate 是单位时间传输的比特数，分辨率、帧率、压缩效率都会把它推高或压低。
边缘节点数量描述的是 CDN 拓扑，不是媒体传输速率。
每天上传量是产品规模指标，不是单个视频每秒传多少比特。
optionExplanations_en: Partition count is a database capacity concept, unrelated to how many bits a video pushes per second.
Bitrate is the number of bits transmitted per unit time, pushed up or down by resolution, frame rate, and compression efficiency.
Edge-node count describes CDN topology, not a media transfer rate.
Daily upload volume is a product-scale metric, not bits per second for one video.

scenario: 用户上传几十 GB 视频；如果文件先经过应用服务器，会占满应用带宽、连接和磁盘临时空间。
q: 上传 API 应如何演进？
options: 只允许小于 10MB 的视频
继续用 POST /upload，让视频字节全程穿过应用服务器
让客户端把视频文件写进 Cassandra 表
presigned URL，multipart 直传 S3
options_en: Only allow videos smaller than 10MB.
Keep POST /upload so the video bytes stream through the application service the whole way.
Have the client write the video file into a Cassandra table.
Return a presigned URL so the client uploads directly to S3 with multipart upload.
why: 大 blob 应绕过应用服务：应用只发 presigned URL、保存元数据，文件字节直接进对象存储，应用层保持轻量、可水平扩展。
why_en: Large videos should bypass the app tier: the server issues a presigned URL and the bytes go straight to object storage.
whenOtherWins: 如果文件很小且需要同步内容校验，直接经应用服务更简单；几十 GB 视频必须走对象存储直传。
tradeoff: 应用层轻量与可扩展 vs 直传对象存储的额外一次握手

termDefinitions.meaning: 后端预先签发、带临时授权的 URL，客户端可用它直接把文件传到对象存储。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A presigned URL is a temporary, backend-issued link that lets a client upload directly to object storage.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件切成多个部分并行上传，最后由存储服务合并成一个对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multipart upload splits a large file into parts uploaded in parallel and assembled into one object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

q_en: How should the upload API evolve?
scenario_en: Users upload videos that can be tens of GB; routing the bytes through app servers would consume app bandwidth, connections, and temporary disk.
optionExplanations: 限制在 10MB 以内能避开这个问题，但直接砍掉了几十 GB 视频这个硬性需求。
小文件走应用服务器没问题，但几十 GB 视频会把应用带宽、连接和磁盘全部打满。
Cassandra 为宽列点查设计，不是给几十 GB 二进制用的存储层。
presigned URL 让应用只签发授权、字节直接进 S3，应用层轻量还能水平扩展，这正是几十 GB 视频要的路径。
optionExplanations_en: Capping uploads at 10MB dodges the issue but throws away the requirement to support tens-of-GB videos.
Small files are fine through the app tier, but tens-of-GB videos would exhaust its bandwidth, connections, and disk.
Cassandra is built for wide-column point lookups, not for holding tens of gigabytes of binary bytes.
A presigned URL keeps the app tier issuing only authorization while bytes flow straight to S3, staying lightweight and horizontally scalable — exactly what tens-of-GB video needs.

scenario: 上传已经改成 presigned URL + multipart upload，直传对象存储。
q: 这个改动的直接收益有哪些？（多选）
options: 应用服务器不承载几十 GB 文件流量
客户端可以分片上传
更容易支持断点续传
自动生成搜索推荐模型
options_en: Application servers no longer carry tens of GB of file traffic.
The client can upload in parts.
Resumable upload becomes much easier to support.
It automatically trains a search/recommendation model.
why: 直传对象存储保护应用层，multipart 把大文件拆成可重试的部分，为断点续传打基础。推荐模型与上传通道无关。
why_en: Presigned multipart upload keeps blob bytes off app servers and makes chunked retry and resume practical.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件切成多个部分并行上传，最后由存储服务合并成一个对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multipart upload splits a large file into parts uploaded in parallel and assembled into one object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上传中断后可以只重传未完成的部分，而不必重新上传整个文件。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A resumable upload lets a client continue an interrupted transfer instead of restarting the whole file.

diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant V as Video Service
    participant S as Object Storage
    C->>V: start upload
    V-->>C: presigned part URLs
    C->>S: upload parts directly
    C->>V: complete upload
    V->>S: verify object
q_en: What direct benefits come from this upload change? (Select all that apply.)
scenario_en: Uploads now use presigned URLs plus multipart upload directly to object storage.
optionExplanations: 应用服务器不再经手几十 GB 的文件流量，带宽和磁盘压力直接被移走。
客户端能把大文件拆成小 part 分开传，单个 part 失败只需重传那一小块。
chunk 级的上传状态天然就是断点续传要用的进度表，续传因此更容易落地。
推荐模型是排序系统的产物，跟上传通道怎么传字节完全是两回事。
optionExplanations_en: Application servers no longer carry tens of GB of file traffic, taking bandwidth and disk pressure off them directly.
The client can split a large file into small parts, so one failed part only needs a small retry instead of a full restart.
Chunk-level upload status is exactly the progress table resumable upload needs, making resume much easier to build.
A recommendation model is produced by a ranking system, unrelated to how the upload path moves bytes.

scenario: VideoMetadata 一年可能有数亿条记录；主要访问是按 videoId 创建、读取、更新标题/状态/对象存储 URL，视频二进制本体已在对象存储。
q: 为什么 Cassandra 按 videoId 分区是 VideoMetadata 的合理候选？
options: Cassandra，按 videoId 分区
S3 作为唯一元数据数据库
浏览器 localStorage
Elasticsearch 作为唯一事务主库
options_en: Cassandra, partitioned by videoId.
S3 as the only metadata database.
Browser localStorage.
Elasticsearch as the only transactional source of truth.
why: 这不是说 Cassandra 适合所有 YouTube 数据，而是这张表访问模式很窄：按 videoId 点查/更新，且需要高可用和水平扩展。
why_en: Cassandra fits VideoMetadata because access is mostly point lookups by videoId and the system needs high availability and horizontal scale.
whenOtherWins: 如果需要强事务、复杂查询或关系约束，关系型/分布式 SQL 更合适；本题主要是 videoId 点查。
tradeoff: 水平扩展与高可用 vs 复杂查询/强事务能力

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个明确的 key 直接读取一条记录，例如按 videoId 查元数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point lookup fetches one record by a specific key, such as looking up metadata by videoId.

q_en: Why is Cassandra partitioned by videoId a reasonable candidate for VideoMetadata?
scenario_en: VideoMetadata may have hundreds of millions of rows; the main access pattern is create, read, and update by videoId, while media bytes live in object storage.
optionExplanations: 访问几乎全是按 videoId 一条一条地查和改，这正好贴合 Cassandra 分区键的强项，还带来高可用和水平扩展。
S3 擅长存大对象字节，但标题、状态这类字段需要频繁更新和索引查询，object storage 做不到。
localStorage 只活在用户设备上，服务端没法用它保存跨用户可查询的状态。
Elasticsearch 长于全文/过滤搜索，但不是为强一致的事务型主存设计的。
optionExplanations_en: Access is almost entirely point lookups and updates by videoId, which lines up with Cassandra's partition key and gives high availability plus horizontal scale.
S3 is good at storing large object bytes, but fields like title and status need frequent updates and indexed queries that object storage cannot do.
localStorage lives only on one device; the server cannot use it to hold state that other users or requests can query.
Elasticsearch is strong at full-text and filtered search, but it is not built as a strongly consistent transactional source of truth.

scenario: VideoMetadata 只需按单个 videoId 点查/更新；不像有些系统要按一致性域精细分片（例如按演唱会 ID 分片保证同场次库存强一致）。
q: 为什么 VideoMetadata 可以直接按 videoId 分区，不需要那种精细分片？
options: videoId 分区就能保证热门视频永远不出现读热点或数据倾斜
视频元数据不会随时间增长
本题主要是单 videoId 点查，没有跨视频的强一致事务
Cassandra 不需要设置分区键
options_en: Partitioning by videoId guarantees popular videos never become a read hot spot or cause data skew.
Video metadata never grows over time.
The workload is mostly single-videoId point lookups with no cross-video transaction.
Cassandra does not need a partition key at all.
why: 本设计不需要按上传者批量查或跨视频事务，只需按 videoId 读一个视频的元数据；分区键要服务访问模式，而不是随意选。
why_en: Partitioning by videoId works because the workload is mostly point lookups without cross-video transactional access.
tradeoff: 按访问模式选分区键 vs 按一致性域强制分片

termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point lookup fetches one record by a specific key, such as looking up metadata by videoId.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被高频访问的一个 key，可能让承载它的节点或副本过载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot key receives disproportionate traffic and can overload the node or replica that serves it.

q_en: Why can VideoMetadata be partitioned directly by videoId?
scenario_en: VideoMetadata is only read or updated by one videoId; unlike inventory systems, it does not need cross-item strong consistency partitions.
optionExplanations: 均匀分区解决的是数据分布，挡不住一个爆款视频把同一个 key 刷成热点。
元数据会随着每次上传持续增长，这个前提本身就不成立。
这里的访问就是单个 videoId 的点查/更新，没有需要跨视频保持一致的事务，分区键只要贴合这个模式就够。
Cassandra 建模仍然需要显式选分区键，不存在不设分区键这回事。
optionExplanations_en: Even partitioning balances data distribution, but it cannot stop one viral video from turning a single key into a hot spot.
Metadata keeps growing with every new upload, so this premise does not hold.
The access here is single-videoId point lookups and updates with no cross-video transaction to keep consistent, so a partition key that matches that pattern is enough.
Cassandra modeling still requires explicitly choosing a partition key; there is no such thing as skipping it.

scenario: 第一版设计只把用户上传的原始文件存进对象存储，不做任何后处理。
q: 只存原始文件、不做后处理，主要问题是什么？
options: 不同设备不一定能播放同一种格式
对象存储无法保存大文件
Cassandra 会自动转码
用户上传时不能填写文件名
options_en: Different devices may not be able to play the same format.
Object storage cannot hold large files.
Cassandra automatically transcodes video.
Users cannot enter a file name while uploading.
why: 设备支持的 container/codec 组合不同，网络条件也不同；原始文件直存覆盖不了兼容性和低延迟播放的要求。
why_en: Storing only the original upload ignores device compatibility and the need for streamable, low-latency renditions.

termDefinitions.meaning: 压缩和解压视频数据的编解码方案，如 H.264、AV1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A codec compresses and decompresses video data, such as H.264 or AV1.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频、音频和元数据打包在一起的文件封装格式，和 codec 是两回事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A container is the file format that packages video, audio, and metadata together, distinct from the codec.

q_en: What is the main problem with storing only the original file and doing no post-processing?
scenario_en: The first design stores only the original uploaded file in object storage and performs no post-processing.
optionExplanations: 不同设备支持的 codec/container 组合不一样，只存原始文件必然有一部分设备打不开。
对象存储本来就是为大文件设计的，这不是只存原始文件会遇到的问题。
转码是处理 Worker 的活，Cassandra 只存元数据，它不会替你转码。
文件名是个元数据字段，跟设备能不能解码播放毫无关系。
optionExplanations_en: Different devices support different codec/container combinations, so storing only the original file will leave some devices unable to play it.
Object storage is built for large files; that is not the problem with storing only the original.
Transcoding is a processing worker's job; Cassandra only stores metadata and never transcodes anything.
A file name is just a metadata field, unrelated to whether a device can decode and play the video.

scenario: 用户上传原始视频后，系统需要让不同设备能播放同一视频，但还没考虑按片段流式加载。
q: 比只保存原始文件更好的下一步是什么？
options: 删除 VideoMetadata
只转码出一个最低清晰度、单一 codec 的版本
转码出多格式 codec/container
把原始文件写入 Review 表
options_en: Delete VideoMetadata.
Transcode into just one lowest-resolution, single-codec rendition.
Transcode into multiple codec/container renditions.
Write the original file into a Review table.
why: 多格式转码解决设备兼容性，VideoMetadata 记录各格式的文件 URL；但整文件仍不利于按需流式下载。
why_en: Transcoding into multiple renditions improves device compatibility, though full-file outputs still do not solve segment-based streaming.
whenOtherWins: 如果是内部系统且设备固定，单一格式可能够用；公开视频平台需要多格式。
tradeoff: 设备兼容性 vs 转码存储与计算成本

termDefinitions.meaning: 压缩和解压视频数据的编解码方案，如 H.264、AV1。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A codec compresses and decompresses video data, such as H.264 or AV1.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频、音频和元数据打包在一起的文件封装格式，和 codec 是两回事。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A container is the file format that packages video, audio, and metadata together, distinct from the codec.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频从一种编码格式转换成另一种编码格式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transcoding converts video from one encoding format into another.

q_en: What is a better next step than storing only the original file?
scenario_en: After the original upload, the system must support different playback devices, but it has not yet introduced segment streaming.
optionExplanations: 删掉 VideoMetadata 会直接打掉播放入口和状态模型，跟解决兼容性毫无关系。
只留最低清晰度能让弱网用户看，但高清设备和用户的体验会被牺牲掉。
按不同 codec/container 组合转码能覆盖主流设备的兼容性，是解决播放问题该走的下一步。
Review 表是另一个功能的数据模型，跟视频后处理完全不相关。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting VideoMetadata breaks the playback entry point and the status model, unrelated to fixing compatibility.
Keeping only the lowest resolution lets weak-network users watch, but it sacrifices quality for everyone with better devices.
Transcoding into multiple codec/container combinations covers mainstream device compatibility, the right next step for the playback problem.
A Review table belongs to an unrelated feature's data model, not video post-processing.

scenario: 系统要让用户几秒内开始播放，并在网络抖动时只下载后续需要的小段视频。
q: 存储视频时最关键的改造是什么？
options: 只保存视频缩略图
拆成几秒长的 segment，每段配多种格式
把每个视频整段拆进数据库行，二进制字段直接存字节
只保留一份完整原始文件
options_en: Only keep video thumbnails.
Split into a few-second segments, each with multiple renditions.
Split each video into database rows and store the raw bytes directly in a binary field.
Only keep one full original file.
why: 小片段让客户端先取首段就能播放，同时后台预取后续片段；多格式片段是自适应码率播放的基础。
why_en: Segmenting video into small playable chunks enables a fast start and adaptive streaming across renditions.
whenOtherWins: 如果是小文件下载或离线观看，整文件下载可以更简单；流媒体平台需要片段化。
tradeoff: 快速起播与弱网适应 vs 后处理流水线复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 播放器根据实时带宽在不同清晰度的片段之间动态切换的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adaptive bitrate streaming lets the player switch between segment quality levels based on live bandwidth.

q_en: What is the key storage change for video streaming?
scenario_en: The system needs playback to start within seconds and download only the next needed pieces when the network fluctuates.
optionExplanations: 缩略图只能给用户一个预览画面，替代不了真正能播放的视频内容。
拆成几秒长的 segment 并配多种格式，客户端拿到首个 segment 就能开播，还能边播边取后续片段。
数据库行不适合存大二进制媒体字节，也没法天然支持按段下载。
只留一份完整原始文件意味着必须等整文件下载完才能播放，跟快速起播的目标正相反。
optionExplanations_en: A thumbnail only gives a preview image; it cannot substitute for playable video content.
Splitting into a few-second segments with multiple renditions lets the client start playing after the first segment and keep fetching the rest in the background.
Database rows are a poor fit for large binary media bytes and cannot naturally support downloading by segment.
Keeping just one full original file means waiting for the whole download before playback, the opposite of a fast start.

scenario: 视频后处理已经改成拆 segment、每个 segment 转多种格式。
q: 这个改动的主要代价是什么？
options: 视频无法被任何设备播放
播放时客户端完全不需要网络
对象存储没办法存储小文件
多维护片段和 manifest
options_en: The video can no longer be played on any device.
The client needs no network connection at all during playback.
Object storage has no way to hold small files.
More segment and manifest bookkeeping to maintain.
why: 系统要拆分、转码、生成 manifest、保存大量片段引用；处理复杂度上升，换来的是真正可流式播放的存储形态。
why_en: Segmented renditions require a more complex processing pipeline and manifest bookkeeping in exchange for real streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 列出可用版本或片段地址的索引文件，播放器靠它找到该下载什么。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A manifest is an index file listing available renditions or segment URLs for the player to follow.

q_en: What is the main cost of this segment-based change?
scenario_en: Post-processing now splits video into segments and transcodes each segment into multiple renditions.
optionExplanations: 分段化的目的正是产出更多设备可播放的版本，不会让视频变得不能播。
播放仍然要联网一段段拉取 segment，只是不用等完整文件下载完。
对象存储完全能存海量小对象，这不是分段化带来的限制。
拆分和多格式转码换来了流式播放能力，代价是要多维护大量 segment 引用和 manifest。
optionExplanations_en: Segmenting is meant to produce more device-playable renditions, not make the video unplayable.
Playback still needs the network to fetch segments one by one; it just no longer waits for the full file.
Object storage can hold huge numbers of small objects; that is not a limitation this change introduces.
Splitting and multi-rendition transcoding buy real streaming capability at the cost of tracking many more segment references and manifests.

scenario: 视频内容已经存进 S3，观看接口是 GET /videos/{videoId}。
q: 这个接口更应该返回什么，而不是直接返回视频二进制？
options: Cassandra 分区表定义
详情页的所有用户评论列表
完整 10GB 视频文件
元数据和 manifest 引用
options_en: Cassandra's partition table definition.
The full list of user comments on the detail page.
The full ten-gigabyte video file.
Metadata plus a manifest reference.
why: 视频内容存 S3/CDN，服务端只需返回元数据和 manifest 地址；真正的片段下载由播放器直接从对象存储或 CDN 完成。
why_en: The watch endpoint should return metadata and a manifest reference, leaving segment bytes to S3 or the CDN.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers close to users and serves it from nearby.

termDefinitions.meaning: 列出可用版本或片段地址的索引文件，播放器靠它找到该下载什么。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A manifest is an index file listing available renditions or segment URLs for the player to follow.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

diagram:
graph LR
    Client[Player] --> API[GET /videos/:id]

q_en: What should this watch endpoint return instead of raw video bytes?
scenario_en: Video content is already stored in S3, and the watch API is GET /videos/{videoId}.
optionExplanations: 分区表定义是运维/建模信息，不是播放器需要拿到的数据。
评论列表属于另一个功能面，不该塞进这个播放接口的返回体。
把完整 10GB 字节塞进响应会直接把应用路径压垮，这正是要避免的事。
应该返回 VideoMetadata 和 manifest 入口，真正的片段字节交给播放器去 CDN/对象存储取。
optionExplanations_en: Partition table definitions are operational/modeling info, not something the player needs.
The comment list belongs to a different feature and should not be crammed into this playback response.
Returning the full ten-gigabyte file would crush the app path, exactly what this endpoint needs to avoid.
It should return VideoMetadata with a manifest entry, leaving the player to fetch actual segment bytes from the CDN or object storage.

scenario: 一个 10GB 视频在 100 Mbps 网络下完整下载大约需要 13 分钟以上。
q: 这个耗时量级最支持哪条设计判断？
options: 应该改用更快的编程语言重写播放器
必须支持分段流式播放，不能等整个文件下载完才能看
应该把视频二进制存进数据库事务里
说明当前带宽已经足够，完全不需要改动现在的播放和下载策略
options_en: The player should be rewritten in a faster programming language.
Playback must support segment-based streaming instead of waiting for the whole file to download.
The video bytes should be stored inside a database transaction.
Bandwidth is already sufficient, so neither the current playback nor the download strategy needs to change.
why: 10GB 约 80Gb，80Gb/100Mbps 约 800 秒，也就是 13 分钟以上；所以不能等完整下载完才播放。
why_en: A ten-gigabyte video can take over thirteen minutes to download at one hundred megabits per second, which is unacceptable before playback starts.
q_en: What design judgment does this download-time estimate support?
scenario_en: A 10GB video on a 100 Mbps connection takes more than about 13 minutes to download fully.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存储容量单位，1GB 约等于 8Gb（gigabits）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: GB means gigabyte; one gigabyte is roughly eight gigabits.

termDefinitions.meaning: 网络吞吐单位，表示每秒传输多少兆比特。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Mbps means megabits per second, a network throughput unit.

optionExplanations: 13 分钟的下载等待跟播放器用什么语言写完全无关，换语言解决不了这个问题。
10GB 视频在 100Mbps 下要等 13 分钟以上，这个等待时间逼着系统必须支持分段流式播放。
把视频字节塞进数据库事务只会让这个耗时问题变得更糟，事务不解决下载时长。
错——等整整 13 分钟才能开播本身就不可接受，恰恰说明播放策略必须改成边下边播。
optionExplanations_en: A thirteen-minute wait has nothing to do with what language the player is written in; rewriting it will not fix this.
A 10GB video takes over thirteen minutes at 100Mbps, and that wait is exactly why playback must support segment streaming.
Stuffing video bytes into a database transaction only makes the timing worse; transactions do not shorten download time.
Wrong — waiting a full thirteen minutes before playback even starts is itself unacceptable, which is exactly why the playback strategy must change to stream while downloading.

scenario: 用户点击播放后希望快速开始，不想等完整视频下载；网络中断也不该浪费已下载的进度。
q: 比整文件下载更合适的播放方式是什么？
options: 每次只下载视频字幕文件
等整个视频文件完整下载完之后再开始播放
按顺序取 segment，边下边播
把视频写进数据库事务里保存
options_en: Only download the subtitle file each time.
Wait for the entire video file to finish downloading before starting playback.
Fetch segments in order and play while still downloading.
Write the video into a database transaction to save it.
why: 片段式播放允许先取前几秒快速开播，后台预取后续片段；即使网络中断，也只影响还没取到的片段。
why_en: Segment-based streaming starts playback after the first small segment and keeps fetching later segments in the background.
whenOtherWins: 如果是离线下载或很小的短视频文件，整文件下载可以更简单；长视频流式播放需要 segment。
tradeoff: 快速起播、断点友好 vs 需要片段化和 manifest 的额外复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

q_en: What playback method fits better than full-file download?
scenario_en: After the user clicks play, playback should start quickly and a network break should not waste all downloaded progress.
optionExplanations: 只下字幕文件根本看不到画面，解决不了播放体验的问题。
等完整视频下载完再播会让起播延迟很高，网络一断进度全部作废。
按顺序取可播放 segment、边下边播，能几秒内起播，断网也只丢还没取到的那部分。
把视频写进数据库事务解决不了播放问题，事务不是媒体分发机制。
optionExplanations_en: Downloading only the subtitle file shows no picture at all and does not fix the playback experience.
Waiting for the full video to finish downloading makes startup latency high, and a network drop discards all progress.
Fetching playable segments in order while playing lets startup happen within seconds, and a network break only loses the segments not yet fetched.
Writing video into a database transaction does not solve playback; a transaction is not a media delivery mechanism.

scenario: 有人建议干脆按固定 5MB 字节数下载视频，而不是按 segment 划分。
q: 为什么“可播放 segment”比笼统的“按 5MB chunk 下载”更合适？
options: segment 是可独立播放单元，字节切片未必可播
chunk 下载会禁止使用 CDN
segment 只能用于数据库
byte chunk 一定无法通过 HTTP 下载
options_en: A segment is an independently playable unit; an arbitrary byte slice may not be.
Byte-chunk downloads would forbid using a CDN.
Segments can only be used with a database.
Byte chunks can never be downloaded over HTTP.
why: 按字节切片不一定落在可解码的边界上；segment 是媒体层面的播放单元，设计表达更清晰。
why_en: Playable segments are media units referenced by manifests, while arbitrary byte chunks may not be independently decodable.
tradeoff: segment：媒体层可播放单元 vs byte chunk：纯字节切片

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

q_en: Why can video post-processing be modeled as a DAG?
scenario_en: Video post-processing includes splitting, transcoding, and manifest generation; many segments have no dependency on each other.
optionExplanations: 要不要禁止上传原始文件，跟处理任务之间怎么依赖是两件不相关的事。
严格单线程顺序执行会白白浪费掉 segment 之间本可以并行的算力。
DAG 是任务依赖图，不是哪种存储服务，这个说法把两个层次搞混了。
拆分先于转码、转码先于生成 manifest，这些依赖单向且无环，没有依赖关系的 segment 可以并行跑在多个 Worker 上。
optionExplanations_en: Whether raw uploads are allowed has nothing to do with how processing tasks depend on each other.
Strict single-threaded execution wastes parallel capacity that independent segments could otherwise use.
A DAG is a task dependency graph, not a kind of storage service — this conflates two different layers.
Splitting precedes transcoding, transcoding precedes manifest generation — these dependencies are one-way and acyclic, so segments with no dependency on each other can run in parallel across workers.

q_en: What system should coordinate this processing graph?

Temporal 这类编排器专门管理有依赖的任务图：谁先跑、状态到哪一步、失败了从哪重试，都由它记录而不是靠人肉盯着。
不记录状态的定时脚本一旦失败就没法知道该从哪一步恢复，撑不住这么多有依赖的任务。
DNS 解析器负责域名到地址的映射，跟视频处理任务的编排毫不相干。
optionExplanations_en: Browser cache lives on the client and cannot schedule dependent tasks across backend workers.
An orchestrator like Temporal manages the dependency graph itself — what runs next, how far each step got, and where to resume after a failure — instead of a human tracking it by hand.
A stateless cron script has no way to know where to resume after a failure, which does not hold up against this many dependent tasks.

q_en: How should intermediate media files be passed between processing tasks?
scenario_en: Processing workers produce large intermediate outputs such as temporary segments and audio files, which should not be passed as raw bytes between workers.
optionExplanations: 大文件塞进消息队列的 payload 会直接拖垮队列吞吐，队列是给小消息设计的。
中间文件写进 S3，Worker 之间只传一个 URL 引用，这样 Worker 保持无状态、可以随便重试。
进程内内存共享只在同一进程有效，分布式 Worker 跨机器根本拿不到这块内存。
Cassandra 单行不适合存大二进制中间产物，这不是它的设计用途。
optionExplanations_en: Stuffing large files into a message-queue payload crushes queue throughput; queues are built for small messages.
Writing intermediate files to S3 and passing only a URL reference between tasks keeps workers stateless and freely retryable.
In-process memory sharing only works within one process; distributed workers on other machines cannot reach it.
A single Cassandra row is not built to hold large binary intermediate output.

optionExplanations_en: Too-large chunks make one failed retry expensive; too-small chunks blow up request and metadata overhead — the 5-10MB anchor is just the tradeoff point between the two.

q: 这类 PATCH 请求的作用是什么？

强制转码所有 segment
校验并把该 chunk 标记为 Uploaded
直接把完整视频返回给播放器
options_en: Cancel and delete the entire multipart upload session.
Force transcoding of every segment.
Verify the part and mark that chunk as Uploaded.

q_en: What is this PATCH request for?
scenario_en: After the client uploads a part, S3 returns a part number and ETag; the backend must confirm the chunk and update VideoMetadata.
optionExplanations: 取消上传会话是丢弃已有进度，跟这个 PATCH 想记录进度的目的正好相反。
强制转码要等完整对象生成之后才触发，不会挂在每次 part 回报上。

客户端这时候连上传都还没完成，播放器更不可能直接拿到完整视频。
optionExplanations_en: Canceling the upload session discards existing progress, the opposite of what this PATCH is trying to record.
Forced transcoding waits until the full object exists; it does not fire on every individual part report.
The backend uses the part number, ETag, and fingerprint to verify the part and mark that chunk as Uploaded, giving resumable upload a trustworthy progress table.

更新每个 chunk 的上传状态
实时选择播放器码率
替代客户端续传状态查询
options_en: Kick off the downstream video processing pipeline.
Update each individual chunk upload status.
Pick the player bitrate in real time.
Replace the client's resumable-progress queries.
why: 完整对象创建后，S3 只发一次对象级通知，适合作为后处理入口；chunk 级进度仍由客户端和后端在上传过程中维护。
why_en: The CompleteMultipartUpload event is a good trigger for downstream video processing once the full object exists.

q_en: What should this object-level completion event trigger?
scenario_en: After the client calls CompleteMultipartUpload, S3 emits one object-level completion event.
optionExplanations: 对象一旦完整落地，这次性的完成事件正好是启动后处理流水线的自然入口。
chunk 级状态是在上传过程中逐个更新的，不是等对象完成后才一次性处理。
码率选择发生在播放阶段，跟上传对象是否完成没有关系。
对象完成事件只触发一次，替代不了客户端上传过程中反复查询续传进度。
optionExplanations_en: Once the object fully lands, this one-time completion event is a natural trigger to kick off the processing pipeline.
Per-chunk status gets updated incrementally during the upload, not all at once when the object completes.
Bitrate selection happens during playback and has nothing to do with whether the upload object is complete.
A one-time completion event cannot replace the client repeatedly querying resumable-upload progress mid-upload.

scenario: Video Service 只负责返回 presigned URL、读写视频元数据和播放入口，不保存本地会话状态。
q: 它应该如何扩展？
options: 固定单机，所有上传都串行处理
把所有视频文件缓存到进程内内存
做成无状态服务，负载均衡后水平扩展
和 CDN 部署在同一个边缘节点里
options_en: Keep it on a single fixed machine, processing uploads serially.
Cache all video files inside the process memory.
Make it stateless behind a load balancer and scale it horizontally.
Co-locate it with the CDN on the same edge node.
why: 无状态 HTTP 服务可以简单地增加实例扩容，负载均衡分发请求；大文件和持久状态分别在 S3 和元数据数据库里。
why_en: The Video Service should stay stateless behind a load balancer so it can scale horizontally.
whenOtherWins: 如果服务维护长连接或本地状态，需要会话亲和或外部状态存储；本题可以设计成无状态。
tradeoff: 水平扩展的简单性 vs 单机部署的低运维成本

q_en: How should the Video Service scale?
scenario_en: The Video Service only issues presigned URLs, reads and writes metadata, and returns playback entry points; it keeps no local session state.
optionExplanations: 固定单机串行处理撑不住高并发的上传和观看请求，量一大就排队。
视频文件本来就不该、也装不进单个进程的内存里。
Video Service 不留本地状态，加实例、挂负载均衡就能线性扩容，状态全在 S3 和元数据库里。
CDN 边缘负责分发媒体内容，不该拿来承载核心 API 的状态和逻辑。
optionExplanations_en: A fixed single machine processing requests serially cannot handle high-concurrency uploads and watches; it just queues up.
Video files should not, and cannot, be cached inside a single process's memory in the first place.
The Video Service keeps no local state, so adding instances behind a load balancer scales it linearly, with all state living in S3 and the metadata store.
CDN edges are for distributing media content, not for hosting the core API's state and logic.

scenario: 每天 1M 上传会形成大量转码 DAG 作业，流量可能突增；处理服务内部有待处理任务队列。
q: Video Processing Service 应如何扩展？
options: 由播放器在用户设备上完成全部转码和分段处理工作
根据队列积压和任务类型弹性增加 Worker
只在数据库触发器里转码
固定一个 Worker 防止并行
options_en: Have the player do all transcoding and segmentation on the user device.
Autoscale workers elastically based on queue backlog and task type.
Only transcode inside a database trigger.
Pin a single worker to prevent parallelism.
why: 转码是 CPU 密集且可并行的工作，队列积压是自然的扩容信号；Worker 池可按任务类型和负载弹性伸缩。
why_en: The processing service should autoscale workers based on queued DAG work and task load.
whenOtherWins: 如果上传量极低，固定 Worker 池更简单；高上传量和突发流量需要弹性处理。
tradeoff: 突发处理弹性 vs 常驻 Worker 池的运维简单性

termDefinitions.meaning: 有单向依赖、不存在环的任务依赖图，常用来描述可并行的处理流水线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A DAG is a task graph with one-way dependencies and no cycles, often used to model a parallel pipeline.

q_en: How should the Video Processing Service scale?
scenario_en: One million daily uploads create many transcoding DAG jobs, traffic can spike, and the processing service has a task queue.
optionExplanations: 让播放器在用户设备上做全部转码，普通设备的算力和电量根本扛不住。
队列一旦积压就是加 Worker 的信号，按任务类型分池弹性伸缩，比固定数量的 Worker 更能扛住上传洪峰。
数据库触发器不该跑 CPU 密集的转码任务，那不是它该承担的职责。
固定一个 Worker 会让本可并行的 DAG 任务全部排队，积压只会越堆越多。
optionExplanations_en: Having the player do all transcoding on the user's device asks ordinary hardware and battery to handle far more than they can.
A growing backlog is the signal to add workers, scaled elastically by task type — that absorbs upload spikes far better than a fixed worker count.
A database trigger should not be running CPU-heavy transcoding work; that is not its job.
Pinning a single worker forces DAG tasks that could run in parallel to queue up, and the backlog only keeps growing.

scenario: VideoMetadata 存在 Cassandra 里，按 videoId 分区，主要访问模式是点查。
q: Cassandra 在这里的扩展优势来自哪里？
options: 只能运行在单节点
把视频二进制自动放进 CDN
支持复杂 SQL join
无主复制+一致性哈希做水平分布
options_en: It can only run on a single node.
It automatically pushes video bytes into a CDN.
It supports complex SQL joins.
Leaderless replication and consistent hashing spread data horizontally.
why: Cassandra 的无主复制和内部一致性哈希适合高可用点查；代价是查询要按访问模式建模，不适合随意 join。
why_en: Cassandra scales metadata through leaderless replication and consistent hashing over the videoId partition key.

termDefinitions.meaningEn: Consistent hashing maps keys onto a hash ring so scaling only reshuffles a small neighboring range.

q_en: Where does Cassandra scaling advantage come from here?
scenario_en: VideoMetadata is stored in Cassandra, partitioned by videoId, with point lookup as the main access pattern.
optionExplanations: 单节点存储根本没有这种能水平扩展的模型，这个说法直接反了。
把视频字节推进 CDN 不是 Cassandra 的职责，那是播放路径上另一层的事。
复杂 SQL join 从来不是 Cassandra 的强项，它的查询要跟着分区键走。
Cassandra 靠无主复制加一致性哈希把数据水平摊到多个节点，这正是它能撑住高并发点查的原因。
optionExplanations_en: A single-node store has no such horizontal-scaling model at all — this is the reverse of what actually happens.
Pushing video bytes into a CDN is not Cassandra's job; that belongs to a different layer of the playback path.
Complex SQL joins have never been Cassandra's strength; its queries have to follow the partition key.
Cassandra spreads data across nodes through leaderless replication plus consistent hashing, exactly what lets it absorb high-concurrency point lookups.

scenario: VideoMetadata 已按 videoId 均匀分区。一个视频突然爆火，数百万用户同时打开详情页，都读取同一个 videoId 的元数据。
q: 为什么“分区均匀”仍然挡不住这种读热点？
options: 上传 API 会退回到最初的单次 POST /upload 形态
S3 无法存储 segment
所有视频都会丢失
承载该 videoId 元数据的节点/副本可能成为读热点
options_en: The upload API would revert to the original single POST /upload form.
S3 would be unable to store segments.
All videos would be lost.
The nodes or replicas holding that videoId can become a read hot key.
why: 分区均匀解决的是数据分布，不等于访问分布均匀；一个热视频会让同一条元数据被反复点查，形成 hot key。
why_en: Uniform data partitioning does not imply uniform traffic; one viral video can create a hot key on the replicas serving that videoId.

termDefinitions.meaning: 被高频访问的一个 key，可能让承载它的节点或副本过载。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A hot key receives disproportionate traffic and can overload the node or replica that serves it.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用一个明确的 key 直接读取一条记录，例如按 videoId 查元数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A point lookup fetches one record by a specific key, such as looking up metadata by videoId.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

q_en: Why can even partitioning still leave this read hot spot?
scenario_en: VideoMetadata is evenly partitioned by videoId, but one viral video is read by millions of viewers at the same time.
optionExplanations: 上传接口长什么样跟观看端的读热点毫无关系，这个选项答非所问。
热点问题出在元数据读流量上，跟 S3 能不能存 segment 完全是两回事。
这只是读请求集中在一个 key 上过载，不是所有视频数据都丢了。
数据分布均匀只保证不同 videoId 分散在不同节点，一个视频爆火时，承载它那个 key 的节点/副本照样会被同一份数据的重复读压垮。
optionExplanations_en: What the upload API looks like has nothing to do with a read hot spot on the watch side; this is a non sequitur.
The hot spot is metadata read traffic, an entirely different issue from whether S3 can store segments.
This is read requests overloading one key, not all video data being lost.

Even data distribution only guarantees different videoIds land on different nodes; when one video goes viral, the node or replica holding that specific key still gets crushed by repeated reads of the same record.

scenario: 某个热视频被大量观看，VideoMetadata 被反复点查，Cassandra 节点开始变热。
q: 如何缓解这个元数据读热点？

给热门元数据加缓存，多副本分担读
把整个视频播放路径上的 CDN 全部禁用掉
把所有视频重新上传
options_en: Delete the manifest.
Cache hot metadata and let more replicas share reads.
Disable the CDN across the entire video playback path.
Re-upload all videos.
why: 缓存热门元数据能让大量读绕过数据库，多副本服务读也能分担压力；内容字节本身则交给 CDN/S3。
why_en: A distributed cache for hot video metadata shields Cassandra from repeated reads, while more replicas spread the remaining load.
whenOtherWins: 如果访问分布均匀且读量低，缓存可以后置；元数据要求强实时时，缓存 TTL 和失效要谨慎设计。
tradeoff: 读扩展与降低数据库压力 vs 缓存新鲜度维护成本

q_en: What is the best mitigation for this hot metadata read path?
scenario_en: A viral video causes repeated VideoMetadata point lookups, and Cassandra replicas for that key start getting hot.
optionExplanations: 删掉 manifest 会直接搞坏播放入口，热点问题一点没解决。
给热门元数据加缓存能拦掉大部分重复读，多副本再分摊剩下的流量，Cassandra 才不会被压垮。
关掉 CDN 只会让原本该走边缘分发的媒体流量全压回源站，跟元数据热点无关还添乱。
重新上传视频不会改变元数据的读热点，代价却极高。
optionExplanations_en: Deleting the manifest just breaks the playback entry point and does nothing about the hot spot.
Caching hot metadata intercepts most repeated reads, and spreading the remainder across more replicas keeps Cassandra from getting crushed.
Disabling the CDN just pushes media traffic that should be at the edge back onto the origin, unrelated to the metadata hot spot and actively harmful.
Re-uploading the video does nothing to change the metadata read hot spot, at a very high cost.

q: S3 和 CDN 在视频播放路径上的角色区别是什么？
scenario: 播放路径要同时用到对象存储和内容分发网络，两者职责经常被混淆。
options: CDN 只能缓存 HTML，不能缓存视频片段
二者都是用户元数据数据库
S3 是源站，CDN 缓存热门内容到边缘节点
S3 负责转码，CDN 负责数据库事务
options_en: A CDN can only cache HTML, not video segments.
Both are user metadata databases.
S3 is the origin; the CDN caches hot content on edge nodes.
S3 handles transcoding, and the CDN handles database transactions.
why: S3 提供持久对象存储，但区域位置可能离用户远；CDN 把内容缓存到边缘，减少长距离传输和缓冲，两者互补。
why_en: S3 stores the origin objects, while a CDN caches manifests and segments at edge locations close to viewers.

q_en: How do S3 and CDN roles differ on the video playback path?
scenario_en: The playback path uses both object storage and a content delivery network, and their responsibilities are easy to mix up.
optionExplanations: CDN 缓存的是各种静态或半静态内容，视频 segment 恰恰是它最常见的缓存对象之一。
S3 和 CDN 都不是用户元数据数据库，这个说法把两者的职责都张冠李戴了。

转码是处理 Worker 的工作，数据库事务是元数据存储的职责，跟 S3、CDN 都不搭边。
optionExplanations_en: A CDN caches all kinds of static or semi-static content, and video segments are one of its most common cache objects.
Neither S3 nor a CDN is a user metadata database; this misassigns both of their jobs.
S3 is the origin for durable objects, and the CDN caches hot content closer to viewers at the edge — one holds, one delivers.
Transcoding is a processing worker's job and database transactions belong to the metadata store; neither maps to S3 or the CDN.

scenario: 用户分布全球，S3 bucket 在单一区域；远离该区域的用户首段加载慢、播放容易缓冲。
q: 应该加入什么来改善播放体验？

把 segment 写进关系型数据库
让 API Gateway 代理并转发所有视频 segment 的 bytes
只增加 Cassandra 分区数
options_en: A CDN that caches hot manifests and video segments.
Write segments into a relational database.
Have the API Gateway proxy and forward every video segment's bytes.
Just add more Cassandra partitions.
why: CDN 让视频片段从离用户更近的边缘节点返回，显著降低延迟和跨区域带宽压力，是流媒体读扩展的核心一环。
why_en: A CDN improves streaming by serving manifests and segments from edge locations near viewers.
whenOtherWins: 如果内容只给同一区域内部用户看，直接 S3 可能够用；全球热门内容需要 CDN。
tradeoff: 边缘低延迟分发 vs 额外的缓存一致性与运维成本

q_en: What should be added to improve playback for global viewers?

optionExplanations: CDN 把热门 manifest 和 segment 缓存到离用户更近的边缘节点，能直接缩短跨区域首段加载的距离。
关系型数据库不是用来存媒体 segment 的，这解决不了跨区域延迟。

Adding more Cassandra partitions changes data distribution but does not shorten the physical distance between viewers and a single-region S3 bucket.

播放器可以直接从 CDN 取后续片段，后端几乎不参与播放字节流
所有片段仍必须经过 Video Service
options_en: The upload flow gets canceled.
Cassandra must run a separate transaction for every single segment download.
The player fetches later segments directly from the CDN, and the backend barely touches the media bytes.
Every segment must still pass through the Video Service.
why: 播放入口由元数据给出，后续 segment 字节由 CDN 服务；这样最热的视频流量不会压垮应用服务。
why_en: When the CDN already has the manifests and segments, playback continues from the edge without routing media bytes through backend services.

optionExplanations: 上传流程有没有取消跟继续播放时命中 CDN 是两件不相关的事。
segment 是媒体对象，不需要 Cassandra 为每一段单独跑事务。
manifest 和后续 segment 已经在 CDN 边缘，播放器直接从那里取字节继续播放，后端服务基本不参与这部分字节流。
让每个片段都经过 Video Service，正是引入 CDN 想绕开的那条路径，这个选项说反了。
optionExplanations_en: Whether the upload flow was canceled is unrelated to a CDN hit during continued playback.
Segments are media objects; Cassandra does not need to run a separate transaction for each one.
With the manifest and later segments already at the CDN edge, the player fetches those bytes directly and the backend barely touches this part of the media stream.
Routing every segment through Video Service is exactly the path introducing a CDN was meant to avoid — this option gets it backwards.

scenario: 产品想缩短用户上传完成到视频可播放的等待时间，愿意让客户端承担更多分段和协调逻辑。
q: 可考虑的优化是什么？

禁用 multipart upload
只保存原始视频
等完整视频完全上传结束后才开始全部后处理步骤，从不优化
options_en: Let the backend start processing segments while the client is still uploading, pipelining upload and post-processing.
Disable multipart upload.
Only keep the original video.
Always wait for the full upload to finish before starting any post-processing step, never optimizing.
why: 上传和后处理流水线化能提前开始转码，减少总等待时间；代价是客户端更复杂，未完成上传可能留下需要清理的中间片段。
why_en: Pipelining upload and processing can make videos available sooner by processing segments before the original upload fully completes.
whenOtherWins: 如果优先简化实现和可靠性，先完整上传再处理更清楚；只有上传体验成为瓶颈时才值得流水线化。

q_en: What optimization could reduce time from upload to playable video?
scenario_en: The product wants to shorten the wait from upload completion to playable video and can accept more client-side segment coordination.
optionExplanations: 边上传分段边让后端提前转码，能在上传还没完全结束时就开始处理，缩短上传完成到可播放之间的等待。
禁用 multipart upload 会连断点续传的基础都一起拆掉，跟缩短延迟毫无关系。
只保留原始视频会丢掉转码和分段产出，播放兼容性问题根本没解决。
永远等完整上传完再处理确实简单，但正是这道题想要优化掉的那段延迟。
optionExplanations_en: Letting the backend start transcoding segments while the client is still uploading begins processing before the upload fully finishes, cutting the wait between upload completion and playability.
Disabling multipart upload also tears down the foundation resumable upload depends on, unrelated to cutting latency.
Keeping only the original video throws away the transcoded, segmented outputs, leaving the compatibility problem unsolved.
Always waiting for the full upload before processing is simple, but it is exactly the delay this question is asking how to cut.

每个商家的平均评分
每个视频的 codec 列表
每个用户对每个视频的播放进度
options_en: Each domain's robots.txt.
Each business's average rating.
Each video's codec list.
Each user's playback progress on each video.
why: 恢复播放位置是用户-视频维度的状态，不是视频本体或全局元数据；它可以作为附加功能单独设计。
why_en: Resuming playback requires storing per-user, per-video watch progress as a new piece of state.

q_en: What extra data does resume playback need?
scenario_en: The product adds resume from last watched position, which is outside the initial core scope.
optionExplanations: robots.txt 是给爬虫看的抓取规则，跟视频播放位置毫不相干。
商家平均评分是 Yelp 类本地商家实体的字段，这道题里根本没有商家概念。
codec 列表描述的是视频本身支持哪些编码，不描述某个用户看到哪里了。
续播要记住的是某个用户在某个视频上看到哪一秒，这是用户-视频两个维度组合出的新状态。

Average business rating is a field on a Yelp-style local-business entity, and there is no business concept in this problem.
A codec list describes which encodings a video itself supports, not where a particular user stopped watching.
Resuming playback needs to remember which second a specific user reached on a specific video — new state keyed on the user-video pair.

城市多边形搜索问题
视频 codec 兼容性问题
options_en: A DNS resolution problem.
A write-scaling problem about maintaining exact or approximate counts.
A city polygon search problem.
A video codec compatibility problem.
why: 观看计数是高频写/聚合问题，可以讨论精确计数、近似计数、批量聚合和延迟展示；它是附加深挖而非主线。
why_en: View counts become a separate write-scaling and aggregation problem, often trading exact counts for approximate ones.

q_en: What kind of deep dive do view counts usually become?
scenario_en: The interviewer decides to include view counts in the design scope.
optionExplanations: DNS 负责域名解析，跟维护一个不断被写入的计数器完全不相干。
每次观看都可能变成一次写入或聚合事件，这就变成了精确计数 vs 近似计数、批量聚合的写扩展问题。
多边形搜索是地理围栏类问题，跟统计观看次数不是一回事。
codec 兼容性影响的是播放能不能解码，不影响计数要不要写入。

Every watch can become a write or aggregation event, turning this into a write-scaling problem about exact versus approximate counts and batched aggregation.
Polygon search is a geofencing-style problem, a different animal from counting views.
Codec compatibility affects whether playback can decode a file, not whether a counter needs to be written.

Multipart upload needs no verification.
Video bytes are allowed to be corrupted freely.
why: 视频平台更重视用户能上传和播放，某些元数据状态短暂滞后可接受；文件完整性和校验仍必须保证。
why_en: Prioritizing availability means metadata or processing state may be briefly stale while upload and playback remain available.
tradeoff: 尽量可用 vs 元数据/状态的短暂陈旧

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers close to users and serves it from nearby.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件切成多个部分并行上传，最后由存储服务合并成一个对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multipart upload splits a large file into parts uploaded in parallel and assembled into one object.

q_en: Where is this availability-over-consistency tradeoff most likely to show up?
scenario_en: The nonfunctional requirement says to favor availability over strong consistency, so it must map to a concrete design point.
optionExplanations: CDN 该缓存的内容照样要缓存，优先可用性不等于关掉缓存能力。
优先可用性落到实处，就是允许元数据偶尔滞后一点，但上传和观看这两条主路径必须一直能用。
优先可用性不等于放弃校验，part 校验还是要做，只是不能让校验挡住可用性。
视频字节损坏是数据完整性问题，优先可用性从不意味着允许内容坏掉。
optionExplanations_en: The CDN should keep caching what it normally caches; favoring availability does not mean turning caching off.
Favoring availability in practice means metadata can lag a little, but the upload and watch paths must stay usable at all times.
Favoring availability does not mean skipping verification; parts still get checked, just without letting that block availability.
Corrupted video bytes is a data-integrity failure; favoring availability never means letting content break.

scenario: 系统必须支持几十 GB 视频、上传中断后继续、低带宽用户也能尽快开始观看。
q: 哪组设计选择能覆盖这些非功能需求？
options: 只使用 Cassandra 存二进制视频
只存视频元数据，不存视频本体
单次 POST /upload 上传 + 整文件全部下载完成后再播放
直传对象存储 + chunk 记录 + segment ABR
options_en: Store the binary video only in Cassandra.
Store only video metadata, never the video itself.
A single POST /upload upload plus full-file download, with playback only after it all finishes.
Direct-to-object upload, chunk tracking, and segment-based ABR.
why: multipart 和 chunk 状态解决大文件与续传，segment/manifest 加 ABR 解决低延迟与弱网播放；其他选项覆盖不了这些约束。
why_en: Multipart direct upload with chunk tracking handles large resumable uploads, while segmented manifests and ABR handle low-latency playback.
whenOtherWins: 小文件分享产品可以直接上传和整文件下载；YouTube 级视频系统不能这样设计。
tradeoff: 覆盖全部非功能约束 vs 实现复杂度

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把大文件切成多个部分并行上传，最后由存储服务合并成一个对象。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Multipart upload splits a large file into parts uploaded in parallel and assembled into one object.

termDefinitions.meaning: 客户端为了断点续传，把大文件切出来的一小块数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A chunk is a small piece of a large file the client uploads separately to support resuming later.

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable chunk of video and the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 列出可用版本或片段地址的索引文件，播放器靠它找到该下载什么。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A manifest is an index file listing available renditions or segment URLs for the player to follow.

termDefinitions.meaning: 播放器根据实时带宽在不同清晰度的片段之间动态切换的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adaptive bitrate streaming lets the player switch between segment quality levels based on live bandwidth.

q_en: Which set of choices best satisfies these nonfunctional requirements?
scenario_en: The system must support tens-of-GB videos, resumable uploads after interruption, and quick playback for low-bandwidth users.
optionExplanations: Cassandra 是为点查设计的宽列库，装不下几十 GB 的视频二进制。
只存元数据、丢掉视频本体，用户根本没有东西可看。
单次 POST 加整文件下载播放是这题最初就被否掉的方案，续传和快速起播都做不到。
直传对象存储解决大文件，chunk 记录解决续传，segment 加 ABR 解决弱网低延迟播放，三条非功能需求正好被这一组选择分别覆盖。
optionExplanations_en: Cassandra is a wide-column store built for point lookups; it cannot hold tens of gigabytes of video binary.
Storing only metadata and dropping the video itself leaves users with nothing to actually watch.
A single POST plus full-file download playback is the exact approach this problem already rejected — no resume, no fast start.
Direct-to-object upload solves large files, chunk tracking solves resume, and segmented ABR solves low-latency weak-network playback — this set covers all three nonfunctional requirements.

scenario: 面试官按 staff 级别的深度要求这道 YouTube 题。
q: staff 级候选人的讨论重点应是什么？
options: 把复杂主题讲透，清晰说明各方案取舍和真实系统约束
把所有功能都放进一个同步请求
避免谈视频处理细节
只背出 S3、CDN、Cassandra 三个名词
options_en: Go deep on complex topics and clearly explain trade-offs and real system constraints.
Cram every feature into one synchronous request.
Avoid discussing video-processing details.
Only name-drop S3, CDN, and Cassandra.
why: staff 级别要在上传、处理、流式播放、缓存/CDN 等主题上展示经验驱动的取舍，而不只是列组件名字。
why_en: A staff-level answer should deeply explain the trade-offs in upload, processing, and streaming rather than merely naming components.

termDefinitions.meaning: 常用的对象存储服务，适合存大文件；不是关系型数据库。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: S3 is an object storage service commonly used to hold large files; it is not a relational database.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把内容缓存在靠近用户的边缘节点、就近返回的网络。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A CDN caches content on edge servers close to users and serves it from nearby.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，靠分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless, distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

q_en: What should a staff-level YouTube answer focus on?
scenario_en: The interviewer expects staff-level depth for this YouTube design.
optionExplanations: 面试官期待听到的是每个决定背后的真实取舍——为什么选 presigned upload、为什么拆 segment、CDN 什么时候救命——而不是背模块名单。
把所有功能塞进一个同步请求，直接违背了大 blob 该走异步分离路径的设计。
视频处理正是这题预期要深挖的地方，回避它反而暴露不出该有的深度。
只报出 S3、CDN、Cassandra 三个名词，说明不了任何一个取舍是怎么来的。
optionExplanations_en: What the interviewer wants to hear is the reasoning behind each call — why presigned upload, why segment the video, when the CDN actually saves you — not a list of component names.
Cramming every feature into one synchronous request directly violates the async, separated path large blobs need.
Video processing is exactly the area this problem expects candidates to go deep on; avoiding it hides the depth that should be there.
Just naming S3, CDN, and Cassandra explains none of the reasoning behind any actual tradeoff.

scenario: 播放方案最终选了 adaptive bitrate streaming（ABR）：客户端读 manifest，按实时带宽在不同清晰度的 segment 之间切换。
q: 相比简单的顺序 segment 下载，选 ABR 的主要代价是什么？
options: 服务端必须在用户播放时对每个片段实时转码切清晰度
manifest 文件必须存进关系型数据库并开启强一致事务
客户端由被动下载变主动决策，且依赖上游三项上传期决策
为省存储每个视频只能保留一种清晰度的单一版本
options_en: The server must transcode each segment on the fly at play time.
Manifests must live in a relational database under strong-consistency transactions.
The client turns from passive downloader into an active decision-maker and depends on three upstream upload-time choices.
To save storage each video can keep only a single quality version.
why: ABR 用弱网不卡换来最高的客户端复杂度：带宽探测和清晰度切换全压在客户端，而且它只有在上传期已完成分段、多格式转码和 manifest 生成时才成立。
why_en: ABR trades weak-network smoothness for the heaviest client complexity — bandwidth probing and quality switching all live on the client — and it only works if segmentation, multi-format transcoding, and manifests were already produced at upload time.

termDefinitions.meaning: 播放器按实时带宽在不同清晰度片段间动态切换的技术。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Adaptive bitrate streaming lets the player switch segment quality levels based on live bandwidth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 列出各版本与片段地址的索引文件，播放器靠它决定下载什么。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A manifest is an index file listing renditions and segment URLs that the player follows.

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，是流式播放的最小下载单元。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable piece of video, the smallest unit fetched while streaming.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频从一种编码转成另一种编码，是后处理里最耗 CPU 的步骤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transcoding converts video from one encoding to another and is the most CPU-heavy post-processing step.

q_en: Compared with plain sequential segment download, what is the main cost of choosing ABR?
scenario_en: The playback approach chosen is adaptive bitrate streaming (ABR): the client reads a manifest and switches between segment quality levels based on live bandwidth.
optionExplanations: 转码是在上传期一次性做好的，不是播放时实时做；这是对处理时机的误解。
manifest 只是 S3 里的索引文本，用不到关系型库和强一致事务。
带宽探测、选格式、切清晰度都在客户端做，而这套逻辑必须依赖上传期已生成的分段、多格式和 manifest。
ABR 恰恰要多清晰度版本才能切换，保留单一版本会让它无从工作。
optionExplanations_en: Transcoding is done once at upload time, not live at play time — this misreads when processing happens.
A manifest is just index text in S3; no relational database or strong-consistency transaction is involved.
Bandwidth probing, format selection, and quality switching all run on the client, and that logic depends on segmentation, multi-format output, and manifests created at upload time.
ABR needs multiple quality versions to switch between; keeping a single version defeats it.

scenario: 要给热门视频的元数据读挡在 Cassandra 前面加一层缓存；元数据永远按 videoId 点查，只有一小撮热视频反复被读。
q: 这层元数据缓存该用什么形态？
options: 分布式缓存，LRU 淘汰，同样按 videoId 分区
单机本地缓存，永不淘汰，把全部视频元数据都常驻在内存里
按上传时间范围分区，方便定期批量扫描最新上传的视频
写穿缓存，每次写都强一致地同步复制到所有缓存副本节点
options_en: A distributed cache with LRU eviction, partitioned by videoId too.
A single-node local cache that never evicts and holds all metadata.
Partition by upload-time range so newest videos can be bulk-scanned.
A write-through cache that synchronously replicates every write to all replicas.
why: 访问只是按 videoId 点查、且只有一小撮热视频，所以缓存分区键跟 DB 对齐(videoId)、用 LRU 只留热点最省内存；代价是缓存只做最终一致，冷数据 miss 后仍要回源 Cassandra。
why_en: Access is a videoId point lookup and only a hot subset is popular, so aligning the cache partition key with the DB (videoId) and evicting with LRU keeps just the hot set — the cost is eventual consistency, and a cold miss still falls back to Cassandra.
whenOtherWins: 如果读的是按时间的批量最新列表而不是单点查，videoId 分区就不再匹配，得换范围友好的组织方式。
tradeoff: 命中热点省 DB 压力 vs 缓存最终一致、miss 要回源

termDefinitions.meaning: 最近最少使用淘汰：内存满时先踢掉最久没被访问的条目，天然只留热点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Least Recently Used eviction drops the entries untouched the longest when memory fills, naturally keeping the hot set.

termDefinitions.meaning: 写穿缓存：每次写同时更新缓存和后端，读到的总是最新，但写更慢。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A write-through cache updates cache and backing store on every write, so reads are always fresh but writes are slower.

termDefinitions.meaning: 无主复制的分布式 NoSQL 数据库，按分区键把数据水平分布到多个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Cassandra is a leaderless distributed NoSQL database that spreads data across nodes by partition key.

termDefinitions.meaning: 决定一条数据落到哪个节点的键；这里选 videoId 让点查只命中一个节点。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A partition key decides which node a row lands on; here videoId makes a point lookup hit a single node.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单个视频的唯一标识，本系统所有元数据查询都按它点查。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: videoId is the unique identifier of a single video, the key every metadata query looks up by.

q_en: What shape should this video-metadata cache take?
scenario_en: You add a cache in front of Cassandra for hot video metadata; metadata is always point-looked-up by videoId, and only a small hot subset is read repeatedly.
optionExplanations: 缓存按 videoId 分区让点查直接命中单节点，LRU 天然保留反复访问的少数视频，分布式把读分摊到多节点，正好贴合访问模式。
365M 条元数据装不进单机，且永不淘汰会撑爆内存，也没有横向扩展。
按时间范围分区是为批量扫描准备的，本系统只做单点查，用不上还会打散热点。
写穿加强一致复制是为写路径的强一致准备的，这里读远多于写，白白拖慢写又占资源。
optionExplanations_en: Aligning the partition key with the DB (videoId) keeps point lookups simple, LRU keeps only the repeatedly-read hot set, and distributing it spreads reads — matching the access pattern.
365M metadata rows do not fit on one node, never evicting would blow up memory, and there is no horizontal scaling.
Time-range partitioning is for bulk scans; this system only point-queries, so it is unused and scatters the hot set.
Write-through with strong-consistency replication targets write-path consistency, but here reads vastly outnumber writes, so it only slows writes and wastes resources.

scenario: 后处理要把每个 segment 转成多个 codec（编解码方案）；选 codec 时要在几个维度上权衡，因为没有哪个 codec 全都最优。
q: 选择视频 codec 时，需要权衡哪些取舍维度？（多选）
options: 压缩耗时（转码要花多久）
跨平台/设备支持程度
压缩效率（体积能缩多小）
是否有损（画质是否保真）
数据库该选哪个分区键
options_en: Compression time (how long transcoding takes).
Cross-platform/device support.
Compression efficiency (how small it shrinks).
Lossy or not (whether quality is preserved).
Which partition key the database should use.
why: codec 在压缩耗时、跨平台支持、压缩效率、有损与否四个维度上取舍；没有全能 codec，所以系统要为每个 segment 存多种格式来覆盖不同设备与网络。
why_en: Codecs trade off on compression time, cross-platform support, compression efficiency, and lossy-vs-lossless — no codec wins on all, which is why the system stores multiple formats per segment to cover different devices and networks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 编解码器：压缩和解压视频的方案，如 H.264、AV1；决定体积与画质。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A codec (encoder/decoder) compresses and decompresses video, like H.264 or AV1, trading size against quality.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把视频从一种编码转成另一种，是后处理 DAG 里最耗 CPU 的步骤。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Transcoding converts video from one encoding to another, the most CPU-heavy step in the post-processing DAG.

termDefinitions.meaning: 单位时间传输的比特数；压缩效率越高，同画质所需 bitrate 越低。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Bitrate is the bits transferred per unit time; higher compression efficiency lets the same quality use a lower bitrate.

termDefinitions.meaning: 几秒长、可独立播放的视频片段，后处理会把它转成多种 codec。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A segment is a short, independently playable piece of video that post-processing transcodes into several codecs.

q_en: Which axes do you trade off when choosing a video codec? (multiple)
scenario_en: Post-processing transcodes each segment into several codecs; choosing a codec means weighing a few axes, because no single codec is best on all of them.
optionExplanations: 转码是后处理 DAG 里最贵的 CPU-bound 步骤，压缩越慢，转码集群成本越高。
决定这个格式能覆盖哪些设备，正是我们要为一个视频存多种格式的原因。
缩得越小，S3 存储和播放时的 bitrate/带宽就越省。
有损换更小体积，无损保画质但文件更大，直接影响用户看到的质量。
分区键是数据库设计问题，跟 codec 的编解码取舍无关，是混入的干扰项。
optionExplanations_en: Transcoding is the most expensive CPU-bound step in the post-processing DAG, so slower compression means a costlier transcode fleet.
It decides which devices a format can reach — exactly why we store multiple formats for one video.
The smaller it shrinks, the less S3 storage and playback bitrate/bandwidth it uses.
Lossy buys smaller files, lossless keeps quality but grows files, directly affecting the quality users see.
A partition key is a database-design question unrelated to codec encode/decode tradeoffs — a mixed-in distractor.
